content.title: Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival
content.text: If you are using a screen reader and are having problems using this website, please call (888) 226-0076 for assistance. Please note, this number is for accessibility issues and is not a ticketing hotline. Important Details No difference in “tiers” other than price. Buy early to save. Prices subject to change while supplies last. Pass Info Payment Plan Info Festival Passes service fees included in price General AdmissionAllows entry into the venue all three days. GA Pass holders may visit the GA camping areas. GA W1 On Sale 5/1 W2 On Sale 5/1 VIPAllows entry into the venue and VIP areas all weekend. VIP Pass holders may visit the GA camping areas. Additional Information VIP areas located at the 12 Peaks area adjacent to the Main Stage and in the Rose Garden offer specialty food & drink vendors, flushable restrooms, shaded seating areas and full cash-less bar. VIP areas adjacent to the Outdoor Theater and Sahara will feature specialty drink options, cash-less bar, extra shade, flushable restrooms. Plus, more amenities. *Subject to their respective capacities W1 On Sale 5/1 W2 On Sale 5/1 Camping service fees included in price Car CampingIf you've never camped, have you really experienced everything Coachella has to offer?Festival passes are sold separately. Learn More Group Car CampingArrive separate, camp together. No waiting for your group to arrive before setting up your camp. A plot in lot 5A will be held for your group to arrive at leisure.New for 2027Group camping spots will allow separate individual spot payments. Check back next week for details.Festival passes are sold separately. Learn More La Campana CampingCamping, but make it nice with private, pre-set temperature controlled tents equipped with real beds for up to four people.Festival passes are sold separately. Learn More Lake EldoradoReady-to-go accommodations for up to four (4) people.Festival passes are sold separately. Learn More Camping Companion ParkingAdditional weekend overnight parking for campers. Learn More Additional Information One (1) overnight parking space for an additional vehicle of campers Parking space valid Thu-Mon. Limit one (1) per order. A very limited amount of Camping Companion Parking Passes are available. If you don’t get one, you’ll have to transport your whole crew and their camping gear in one vehicle. Located adjacent to the campgrounds, but may not be near your campsite. All vehicles will be thoroughly searched. Everyone in the vehicle must be wearing a Festival Wristband. No wristband = No entry to lot. No camping or sleeping in your car. Vehicle check in time: Thu 9am-2am; Fri & Sat 9am-8pm; Sun 9am-3pm Upon entry, proceed to Camping Companion Parking. No ins/outs. No exit during lockdown hours Fri-Sun 9pm-2am Your Companion Camping Parking card is surrendered at entry to claim your spot. If you need to leave Camping Companion Parking prior to 2am on any night, you must do so before 9pm on Fri-Sun. All hours are subject to change based on safety concerns and traffic conditions. If you drive out, you will forfeit your spot. NO re-entry. To park again, you will be redirected to an offsite parking location. Shuttle pass will be required. Pro Tip: Pack your heavy supplies in the vehicle that will be parked in your Car Camping site. Save your strength on the walk from Car Companion Camping. *subject to change W1 On Sale 5/1 W2 On Sale 5/1 Safari CampingThe ultimate on-site camping experience, complete with Guest Passes, golf cart transportation and more. Learn More The Resort at CoachellaAn unparalleled luxury experience within the Safari Campground—crafted for guests who want it all. Learn More Parking & Shuttles service fees included in price Coachella Shuttle PassSkip the drive & parking hassle! Hop on at any participating stop and travel to/from the festival in comfort and ease. Available via 100x Hospitality. Additional Information Shuttles are your BEST choice for transportation to and from the Festival. Shuttles have dedicated routes to ensure the fastest travel to and from the Festival. Shuttles drop off and pick up closest to the Festival Entry. (Shortest walk) AVOID DRIVING AND PARKING AT THE FESTIVAL. W1 On Sale 5/1 W2 On Sale 5/1 Preferred ParkingPark and enter the Venue through the north entrance. Good for the entire weekend. Show More Pass good all 3 days. Open Friday thru Sunday 11am-2am*. No entry allowed after 10pm. Cars left after 2am will be towed. No vehicle ins & outs. Everyone in the vehicle must be wearing a Festival Wristband. No pick-ups or drop-offs. Vehicle size limit 8.5’ x 16’ *Times subject to change. W1 On Sale 5/1 W2 On Sale 5/1 Add-Ons service fees included in price 2027 Lineup Poster18×24 collectible print shipped directly to you. Travel service fees included in price Hotel PackagesGA or VIP festival passes with Coachella Shuttle service and shack up at one of our hand-selected hotels.
